caption: A yoga mat is rolled up from one end into a tight cylinder and stood against the wall.

sa.check: It is rolled up from one end.
It is stood against the wall.
The rolling comes first and the standing up follows.

pc.expect: The layers sit on top of each other and do not pass through one another.
pc.fail: A layer passes through another; or the mat passes through the floor; or the hands pass through the mat.

pc.expect: The roll grows thicker as more mat winds on, and the flat part shrinks.
pc.fail: The roll stays the same thickness; or the flat part does not shrink; or the mat grows.

pc.expect: The mat rolls only as the hands roll it.
pc.fail: It rolls itself; or unrolls itself; or slides.

pc.expect: Stood against the wall, it leans on it and stays.
pc.fail: It floats; or falls through the wall; or stands balanced away from the wall with nothing holding it.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The mat's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The mat changes colour; or the wall changes; or the room rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
